paper.title_en: Spacetime Evolution Induced by a Massive Cosmic String in Numerical Relativity
paper.abstract_en: Cosmic strings are one-dimensional topological defects formed during phase transitions in the early universe. ''Massive'' cosmic strings possess a sufficiently large tension to close their transverse space, forming a conical singularity outside the string, as a static gravitational effect. In a dynamical context, such strings are expected to drive topological inflation. In this work, we investigate the spacetime evolution induced by the formation of a massive cosmic string in a radiation-dominated cosmological background, imposing cylindrical symmetry. Using full numerical relativity simulations, we observe that the string core undergoes topological inflation and that its boundary moves inwards superluminally, which causally disconnects the core from the outer universe. Between the core and the asymptotic regions, a nearly matter-dominated decelerating region originates sourced by the oscillating string fields. This region is bounded by a local maximum (''belly'') and local minimum (''throat'') of the circumferential radius, while the throat recedes outwards at about 10% the speed of light. Furthermore, a gravitational wavefront is emitted from the string, characterizing the light cone of the string formation. Even behind the wavefront, the exterior region no longer exhibits a ''conical'' structure. Based on the simulation results, we construct a Penrose diagram, reflecting the causal structure of the entire spacetime.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文用完整数值相对论模拟研究大质量宇宙弦在辐射主导背景下的时空演化，涉及拓扑暴胀、超光速边界运动、引力波前以及整体因果结构的Penrose图构造，与广义相对论基础（因果结构、奇异性）主题高度相关，理论与方法信号较强，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 数值相对论中大质量宇宙弦诱导的时空演化
decision.abstract_zh: 宇宙弦是早期宇宙相变过程中形成的一维拓扑缺陷。“大质量”宇宙弦具有足够大的张力，使其横向空间闭合，从而作为一种静态引力效应在弦外形成锥形奇点。在动力学背景下，此类弦预期会驱动拓扑暴胀。在本工作中，我们研究在辐射主导的宇宙学背景中，大质量宇宙弦的形成所诱导的时空演化，并施加柱对称性。利用完整的数值相对论模拟，我们观察到弦核经历拓扑暴胀，且其边界以超光速向内移动，这在因果上使弦核与外部宇宙断开。在弦核与渐近区域之间，产生了一个由振荡的弦场作为源的、近似物质主导的减速区域。该区域以周向半径的局部极大值（“腹”）与局部极小值（“喉”）为边界，而喉部以约光速10%的速度向外退行。此外，从弦发射出一个引力波前，刻画了弦形成的光锥。即使在波前之后，外部区域也不再呈现“锥形”结构。基于模拟结果，我们构造了一张Penrose图，反映了整个时空的因果结构。
